# apollo_subgraph (Resource)

Represents an existing GraphOS subgraph registration for a specific variant. New subgraphs are created in GraphOS by publishing schema, so this resource supports brownfield import, read, and delete but does not bootstrap or update registrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apollo_subgraph" "products" {
  graph_id = "inventory"
  variant  = "production"
  name     = "products"
}

import {
  to = apollo_subgraph.products
  id = "inventory:production:products"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph_id` (String) Owning graph identifier.
- `name` (String) Subgraph name.
- `variant` (String) Variant that owns the subgraph registration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic stable identifier in the form `graph_id:variant:name`. Import format: `graph_id:variant:subgraph_name`.
- `revision` (String) Current GraphOS revision identifier for the registered subgraph, when available.
- `routing_url` (String) Routing URL returned by GraphOS for the registered subgraph.

## Import

Import an existing subgraph registration with its graph identifier, variant, and subgraph name:

```terraform
import {
  to = apollo_subgraph.products
  id = "inventory:production:products"
}
```

## Permissions

- Read, import, and refresh require graph read or broader org access.
- Delete requires graph admin or broader org access.

## Boundary

New subgraph registrations and schema changes are still driven by schema publication, such as Rover or a future schema-publish-backed provider workflow. `apollo_subgraph` only supports brownfield import, read, and delete in this slice.
